summary: community.general deprecated its keycloak redirects to middleware_automation.keycloak, including authentication_v2, authz scope/custom policy/permission modules, client, client_rolemapping and client_rolescope, for removal in 16.0.0.
questions: What FQCN should I use for keycloak_authz_permission?
When is the keycloak_client_rolemapping redirect removed?

answer_card.title: community.general keycloak redirects deprecated
answer_card.answer_md:
These community.general **redirects** to `middleware_automation.keycloak` are deprecated and will be removed in **community.general 16.0.0**. Switch your tasks to the FQCN `middleware_automation.keycloak.<module>` now (install it with `ansible-galaxy collection install middleware_automation.keycloak`).

- `keycloak_authentication_v2`
- `keycloak_authz_authorization_scope`, `keycloak_authz_custom_policy`, `keycloak_authz_permission` (+ `_info`)
- `keycloak_client`, `keycloak_client_rolemapping`, `keycloak_client_rolescope`
